description: Search hotels in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Goa. For Dubai and Abu Dhabi, returns Fostay's hand-curated edit first (8 flagship stays with editorial verdicts), then catalog matches (~2,000 bookable hotels). For Goa, returns the best-reviewed hotels and resorts (hostels and homestays only when searched by name), optionally narrowed to one area. Use get_live_rates for prices. Results include a fostay_url where a human can view photos, live rates and book.

area.description: Goa only: narrow to one area — candolim-calangute-baga (Candolim, Calangute & Baga); anjuna-vagator (Anjuna, Vagator & Assagao); morjim-mandrem-arambol (Morjim, Mandrem, Arambol & Siolim); panaji-old-goa (Panaji & Old Goa); south-goa-beaches (Colva, Benaulim, Varca & Cavelossim); palolem-agonda (Palolem & Agonda)

min_rating.description: Minimum guest rating on a 10 scale, e.g. 8
